info.title: E621
info.description:
OpenAPI definition for E621's API. You can find the source [here](https://github.com/DonovanDMC/E621OpenAPI)
This document is intended to compliment E621's existing [API Documentation](https://e621.net/help/api).
If the api is not working, you can check this [Unofficial Status Page](https://status.e621.church).
An MCP server exposing this API to Claude and other MCP clients is available at [mcp.e621.wiki](https://mcp.e621.wiki) (also reachable at [e621.wiki/mcp](https://e621.wiki/mcp)); see its [README](https://github.com/DonovanDMC/E621OpenAPI/tree/master/mcp) for details.

get.description:
Returns e621's [OpenID Connect discovery document](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-discovery-1_0.html),
advertising its OAuth 2.0/OIDC endpoints and the capabilities it supports on them.

get.summary: Get OpenID Connect JSON Web Key Set
get.description:
Returns the [JSON Web Key Set](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7517) used to verify the
signature of issued ID tokens, as advertised by `jwks_uri` in the discovery document.

Returns claims about the authenticated user, gated by the scopes granted to the access token.
Also reachable via POST with an identical response.

post.description:
OAuth 2.0 token endpoint. Supports the `authorization_code` and `refresh_token` grant types.
The client can authenticate with `client_id`/`client_secret` as form fields (below) or via HTTP Basic Auth instead.

redirect_uri.description: Required for the `authorization_code` grant type. Must match the `redirect_uri` used to obtain `code`.

code_verifier.description: Required for the `authorization_code` grant type (PKCE is enforced).

scope.description: Space-separated list of scopes to narrow the token to. Only used by the `refresh_token` grant type.

client_id.description: Required unless authenticating via HTTP Basic Auth instead.

client_secret.description: Required unless authenticating via HTTP Basic Auth instead, or the client is public.

400.description: Invalid request, client, grant, or scope.

post.description:
[RFC 7009](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7009) token revocation. Always responds
with 200 and an empty body, even if the token was already invalid - the client can authenticate
with `client_id`/`client_secret` as form fields (below) or via HTTP Basic Auth instead.

token.description: The access or refresh token to revoke.

client_id.description: Required unless authenticating via HTTP Basic Auth instead, or the token was issued without a client.

client_secret.description: Required unless authenticating via HTTP Basic Auth instead, or the token was issued without a client.

403.description: The token was issued to a different client than the one making this request.

post.description:
[RFC 7662](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7662) token introspection. The caller must
authenticate as the token's OAuth client (`client_id`/`client_secret` as form fields below, or
HTTP Basic Auth), or present the token itself as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.

token.description: The access or refresh token to introspect.

200.description: Success. Note that an unrecognized, expired, or revoked token is reported as `{"active": false}`, not an error.

401.description: Client or bearer token authentication failed.

get.description: Returns metadata about the access token used to authenticate the request.
